title: Board dogfood - end-to-end against linked fixture projects
description: WHY: the epic acceptance requires the full loop proven, and the board is where every phase converges. WHAT: an end-to-end scenario using Playwright-managed Chromium against the console (never system Chrome): create two disposable fixture project workspaces, link both, file work in each including one cross-project portfolio container, capture and route an inbox item, then drive the board - verify lanes and rails render, execute a reserve drag and a refused close drag (gates unsatisfied), satisfy the gate via CLI, complete the close drag, and confirm the portfolio container unblocks after rollup refresh. Record the run as artifact evidence (screenshots plus transcript) attached to this task and the sprint container. Also update docs: getting-started section for the global manager covering link, capture, global next, and the board.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E scenario passes in CI covering link, capture-route, refused drag with gap rendering, satisfied close, and cross-project unblock
Artifact evidence attached to the sprint container
Getting-started docs cover the global manager loop
